sections.heading: Heads of Terms: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
sections.text:
Heads of Terms: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
These heads of terms are not legally binding, except for paragraph 9.

sections.heading: 1. Parties
sections.text:
1. Parties
Northwind Analytics Limited, a company incorporated in England and Wales with company number 01234567, registered office 10 Example Street, Exampletown XX1 1XX; and Bluefield Robotics GmbH, a company incorporated in Germany with registration number HRB 987654, registered office Musterstrasse 5, 10115 Berlin.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose
sections.text:
2. Purpose
Evaluating a possible joint development of warehouse picking software.

sections.heading: 3. Additional Confidential Information
sections.text:
3. Additional Confidential Information
Confidential Information also includes product roadmaps and test data.

sections.heading: 5. Permitted recipients
sections.text:
5. Permitted recipients
Each party may also disclose to its actual or prospective funders, on the same terms.

sections.heading: 6. Duration
sections.text:
6. Duration
The agreement lasts three (3) years. The confidentiality obligations survive for five (5) years after it ends.

sections.heading: 7. Retention
sections.text:
7. Retention
A party may keep copies it is required to keep by law, which remain confidential.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law
sections.text:
8. Governing law
English law; courts of England.

sections.heading: 9. Confidentiality of these heads of terms
sections.text:
9. Confidentiality of these heads of terms
These heads of terms are themselves confidential.

sections.heading: 10. Timetable
sections.text:
10. Timetable
The parties aim to sign the agreement within two weeks.
